title: Bring figure-8 volume as depth-2 grouplike value (50-digit numerical witness)
html:
Conjecture. Bring figure-8 volume as depth-2 grouplike value (50-digit numerical witness)

Conjecture (Bring figure-8 volume as depth-2 grouplike value; 50-digit canonical witness).

The hyperbolic volume of the figure-8 knot 4_1 embedded in Bring's genus-4 surface (rem:figure-8-archimedean-illustration) equals the standard-part of 2\,\mathrm{Im}\,\mathrm{Li}_2^q at the regular-ideal-tetrahedron shape parameter z = e^{i\pi/3} — the depth-2 grouplike value predicted by conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence:

  \mathrm{Vol}(S^3 \setminus 4_1)
  \;=\;
  \mathrm{std}\bigl( 2\,\mathrm{Im}\,\mathrm{Li}_2^q(e^{i\pi/3}) \bigr)
  \;=\;
  2\,\mathrm{Cl}_2\!\left(\tfrac{\pi}{3}\right).

canonical witness (50-digit precision)

Computed via exact algebraic structures.polylog at mp.dps = 50 (formalism the canonical formalism, witness gb-depth-period-bring-fig8.witness.json):

  2\,\mathrm{Cl}_2(\pi/3)
  \;=\;
  2.029{,}883{,}212{,}819{,}307{,}250{,}042{,}405{,}108{,}549{,}040{,}571{,}883\ldots

A SnapPy-precision sanity check via independent Clausen-series partial sum (2 million terms) agrees to \sim 13 digits — the working precision of SnapPy 3.3.2's verified hyperbolic structure. The 50-digit value is the canonical algebraic computation.

Depth correspondence

Side Object Depth
Algebraic 2\,\mathrm{Li}_2^q(e^{i\pi/3}) \in G^{(2)}(\mathcal{H}_q) iterated-integral depth = 2
Archimedean \mathrm{Vol}(4_1) \in \mathcal{P}_2 / \mathcal{P}_1 Goncharov period-depth = 2

A single \mathrm{Li}_2 factor on the algebraic side maps to a single Bloch-regulator class on the geometric side: depth 2 = 2 match, by construction of the Bloch–Wigner regulator ([bloch2000], [suslin1991]).

Bring-specific significance

The figure-8 knot is the canonical knot-theoretic witness for Bring's surface in this paper (def:brings-coordinate-ring). Its 4-strand braid word \sigma_1\sigma_2^{-1}\sigma_1\sigma_2^{-1} realises inside the genus-4 handlebody, and amphichirality 4_1 \cong 4_1^{\,\mathrm{mirror}} pins it as a mass invariant rather than a chirality invariant. Two structural facts already in the paper are consistent with the depth-2 reading:

  • The \pi in \mathrm{Vol}(4_1) = 2\,\mathrm{Cl}_2(\pi/3) and the \pi in the Bring zero-mode \alpha_{EM} correction 2g/(4\pi(g-1))|_{g=4} = 2/(3\pi) share a single provenance — the unique archimedean shadow of pentagon-coherent substrate data on Bring's surface (cf. rem:figure-8-archimedean-illustration).
  • Both factor through the Bloch–Wigner dilogarithm at a Bring shape parameter — exactly the depth-2 grouplike of \mathcal{H}_q.

The depth correspondence predicts analogous canonical witnesses at every depth:

Depth-2 ceiling for hyperbolic 3-manifold volumes. All hyperbolic 3-manifold volumes (figure-8, Borromean rings = 8G, Whitehead link, \ldots) are depth-2 periods — one \mathrm{Li}_2 factor in their Bloch–Wigner formula. Different knots correspond to different shape parameters at the same depth. A genuine depth-3 witness therefore requires either (a) a trilog \mathrm{Li}_3 at an algebraic argument, (b) a Chern–Simons invariant (the depth-3 part of the complexified volume \mathrm{CS} + i\,\mathrm{Vol} \in \mathbb{C}/\pi^2\mathbb{Z}), or (c) a multiple zeta value such as \zeta(3). The Bring-natural choice is (a) at the primitive 5th root of unity \zeta_5 — see conj:bring-trilog-depth-3-witness.
